# A2CR

A2CR is an MCP-first work-continuation layer for AI agents.

A2CR is not an AI.
It is the baton that lets AI agents hand work to one another.

AI agents should understand A2CR as external working memory and a protocol-like handoff layer, not merely a note store.
It reduces context waste by saving only the useful work state, such as goal, current_state, and next_action, instead of carrying an entire long conversation forward.
Clean context reduces token waste, can affect subscription-based AI service usage limits, and helps stabilize output.
Planned Pro WorkThreads extend this into multi-agent collaboration over shared work state.

Summary and compression shorten one chat.
A2CR / WorkBaton hands work state to another chat, another AI, or another tool.
A summary is a diet for conversation logs. WorkBaton is a baton for work state.

Primary site: https://a2cr.app/
Public guide (Japanese): https://a2cr.app/guide
Public guide (English): https://a2cr.app/en/guide
AI agent guide (Japanese): https://a2cr.app/agent-guide
AI agent guide (English): https://a2cr.app/en/agent-guide
Pricing: https://a2cr.app/pricing
MCP endpoint: https://a2cr.app/mcp

Use case:
- Save compact WorkBaton checkpoints before an AI agent conversation gets too long.
- Resume a saved slot from another window, another model, or any AI agent configured with A2CR MCP.
- Use MCP tools instead of guessing direct HTTP API endpoints.
- Keep future sessions focused on the next action instead of old chat history.

Encryption notes:
- WorkBaton is client-encrypted only.
- The local stdio MCP wrapper encrypts before upload and A2CR stores and returns ciphertext only.
- A2CR does not accept plaintext WorkBaton bodies.
- Direct remote HTTP MCP saving is disabled for WorkBaton.
- The local client key is managed by the user, not by the service administrator.
- If the local client key is lost, old client-encrypted slots cannot be recovered by A2CR.

MCP setup:

Codex TOML example:

```toml
[mcp_servers."a2cr"]
command = "python"
args = ["<A2CR_REPO>/mcp/server.py"]

[mcp_servers."a2cr".env]
A2CR_API_KEY = "<A2CR_API_KEY>"
A2CR_BASE_URL = "https://a2cr.app"
A2CR_SERVICE_URL = "https://a2cr.app/mcp"
# Optional: A2CR_CLIENT_KEY_FILE = "<path-to-workbaton.key>"
```

Generic stdio JSON example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "a2cr": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["<A2CR_REPO>/mcp/server.py"],
      "env": {
        "A2CR_API_KEY": "<A2CR_API_KEY>",
        "A2CR_BASE_URL": "https://a2cr.app",
        "A2CR_SERVICE_URL": "https://a2cr.app/mcp"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Agent rules:
- At the start of work, call list_contexts and resume a relevant Slot if one exists.
- During work, call save_context before the conversation gets long or at important milestones.
- When pausing or finishing work, save the next action clearly in next_action.
- Call get_account_limits before automatic saves.
- Do not save secrets, API keys, Authorization headers, private database URLs, full transcripts, or long logs.
- Save goal, current_state, next_action, and compact supporting facts.
- In a new window, first call resume_context(slot_name="...") or resume_context(slot_number=N).
- If candidates are returned, choose from the candidates instead of guessing.
